context_note: Shackelford et al. 2019 meta-analysis, Mediterranean climates only. Yield pools 12 food crops (maize in 21 pubs, plus tomato, pepper, lettuce), so it is NOT a corn-specific estimate; no soybean data. Almost all yield studies were irrigated (36 of 38 pubs) and fertilized in both treatments. The overall all-cover-crop yield effect was non-significant (value shown only in Fig. 2). Down-weight or label as indirect evidence for corn.

Sign: this is a DECREASE (-7%, R = 0.93). Same caveats as E1: Mediterranean, mostly irrigated, food crops pooled (not corn-specific), fertilizer added to both treatments. Mixtures of legumes and non-legumes had intermediate, non-significant yield effects.
